name: How long does baseboard repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does baseboard repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of baseboard repair depends on the scope and complexity of the damage. Small repairs, such as filling a few dents or cracks, might take only a few hours. More extensive projects, like replacing multiple sections due to significant water damage or pet damage across several rooms, could take a day or more, including drying times for sealants and paint. When planning a project with Maine Results, we provide a clear timeline after our initial assessment, considering factors like material procurement and site conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Baseboard repair duration varies from a few hours for minor fixes to a day or more for extensive damage, depending on project scope and drying times.
